_comment: Canton-capital total tax burden (%) at 5 reference income levels. Source of truth for per-canton withholding-tax precision in components/comparators/SalaryCompare.tsx (services/cantonSalary.ts:cantonTaxBurdenPct). Single source, no duplicated constants.
_methodology: ESTV (Swiss Federal Tax Administration) 'Steuerbelastungsstatistik' / Tax burden statistics tool does not publish a single flat national withholding curve; burden differs materially by canton (communal+cantonal multiplier stacks on top of the same federal schedule). Each canton is represented by its official capital/Hauptort commune as a single, citable reference point (consistent with published canton-ranking methodology; avoids skew from population-weighting hundreds of small Ticino communes vs few Geneva communes). Reference taxpayer: single, no children, no religious affiliation (zero church tax - the app does not model religion), tax year 2024 (latest finalized/closed year at data-pull time). Values are 'Total tax burden in %' = (federal + cantonal + communal + personal tax) / gross income - i.e. pure income-tax burden, EXCLUDING social security contributions (AVS/AI/APG/AC/LPP), which the app already models separately via CH_SOCIAL_RATE. Linear interpolation between the 5 reference points approximates the progressive curve; flat-clamped beyond the first/last point.

_sources.estvTaxBurdenTool: https://swisstaxcalculator.estv.admin.ch/#/taxburden/income-wealth-tax - official ESTV 'Geographical comparison' export, all 26 cantons, machine-read via the tool's 'Export table as XLS file' action.
_sources.referenceScenario: Single taxpayer, no children, no religion (no church tax), income tax, tax year 2024, at gross income CHF 30'000 / 60'000 / 100'000 / 150'000 / 250'000 (matches the app's existing bracket boundaries).
